critical_code_review_comments: orders.py cancel_own_withdrawal: correct use of conditional update (status:'pending') to make cancel idempotent — atomic, race-safe.
orders.py vip_balances: frozen aggregation includes both 'pending' AND 'approved' statuses — matches spec (funds locked while admin is processing).
admin_withdrawals.py: cancelled-guard placed BEFORE _assert_paid_lock and evidence validation — correct order (no accidental writes to a cancelled row).
admin_withdrawals.py: per-status timestamp only written when new_status != current — good idempotency (no timestamp drift on repeated same-status PUTs).

deposits.py: network is Optional and only validated when provided AND non-empty — non-crypto flows unaffected. But note: network is stored ONLY when method=='crypto' (line 241 `network if method == 'crypto' else None`), so transfer/cash deposits will always show network=None — expected.

orders.py cancel_own_withdrawal: sets balance_refunded=True in the same $set. If a race lets an admin flip status to 'rejected' AFTER cancel, _reconcile_balance_on_status_change would treat entering_rejected as True (was_rejected=False) but is guarded now by the cancelled 409 in admin route — safe. Confirmed no double-credit path.
